topics.nextAction: Retain the Wave 7.70 two-channel no-go; reopen only with resolved pre-fold outer channels, a source-native triality lift, or a nonlinear invariant outside the generic two-mode family.
topics.closure: Wave 7.70 proves that the complete calibrated complex response of the canonically normalized fold is exactly an ordinary two-oscillator response across 1,604 tests. The proposed discriminator survives only as a pre-fold intervention: unequal addressed outer detunings raise the symmetric-port Krylov rank from two to four.
topics.killTest: Fired for the declared two-channel LTI scope: ordinary coupling, damping, AM/FM mixing and readout calibration absorb every long/short-root response signature.

topics.label: Hecke operator or modular-trace test
topics.question: Does the Monster-order address construction support explicit operators satisfying declared Hecke relations or a graded trace with the required modular identities?
topics.nextAction: Identify the corpus order-23 cycle with a declared oriented 23AB generator, construct cross-grade VOA/defect composition or order-23-twined genus-two sewing, and test the C4 metaplectic multiplier. Keep Rule 60 as the group-algebra operator 1+sigma, not a Monster element.
topics.closure: A source-declared class-sensitive lift produces a nontrivial operator family and graded trace satisfying the preregistered modular identities without fitting address occupancy.
topics.killTest: The oriented identification fails, every class-sensitive record collapses to the same scalar trace, or its operator law violates the required modular identities.
topics.progress: The scalar genus-one bridge is exact. The two Golay factors contract canonically, relative to a declared primitive 23rd root, to the conjugate norm-two ideals (2,alpha) and (2,alpha+1); only their final naming as 23A versus 23B remains conventional. The 529 fixed-point-module characters reduce to 25 scalar types, and the assembled scalar duality-defect trace is fifth-power invariant. The exact order-23 centralizer is C23 x S4. Its five insertion classes give cyclic product families 23AB, 46AB, 46CD, 69AB and 92AB; every A/B McKay--Thompson pair is equal. The order-24 Monster anomaly transgresses trivially along the order-23 factor, making the centralizer action linearisable; those five class traces determine the full graded S4 module, and scalar word traces add nothing. The entire genus-one centralizer-representation route is therefore exhausted. The live computation is cross-grade VOA/defect composition or genus-two sewing with its metaplectic multiplier. Separately T^89=sigma^2 on the Rule-60 Golay image, while ord(T)=23*89 and 89 does not divide the Monster order, ruling out Rule 60 itself as a Monster element.
